title: The Ritual Sacrifice
description: Fenna Voss followed a traveling preacher out of Millbrook three weeks ago, chasing a kinder god. His people camp in the ruined temple north of town. Word came last night that they mean to bleed her at the full moon.

objectives.description: Track the cult to the ruined temple north of Millbrook

notes: Rescue kind 1 of 4: the captive does not want to come back. Threat: Fenna is due to die at the ritual whether or not she consents to it. Giver motive: the priest's own guilt at confirming her, and shame at telling her father the truth. Consequence of refusal: she dies believing what she was told; no path exists yet to let a rescued-but-unwilling victim choose to stay, which would need a real branch - recorded as a second path this pass could not wire.
